caption_en: In 1882 the urbanist Milan Lenuci drew a U of park squares for the Lower Town. People call it the Green Horseshoe.
caption_sv: Urbanist Milan Lenuci osmislio je 1882. niz trgova s perivojima u obliku slova U za Donji grad. Zovu ga Zelena potkova.

caption_en: It has seven squares on three straight lines. Going clockwise, it starts at Zrinjevac.
caption_sv: Ima sedam trgova na tri ravne crte. U smjeru kazaljke na satu počinje Zrinjevcem.

caption_en: The main railway station closes King Tomislav Square in the south. Ferenc Pfaff designed it, and it opened on 18 August 1892.
caption_sv: Glavni kolodvor zatvara Trg kralja Tomislava s juga. Projektirao ga je Ferenc Pfaff, a otvoren je 18. kolovoza 1892.

caption_en: The Art Pavilion has an iron frame made for the 1896 Millennium Exhibition in Budapest. It was shipped to Zagreb and opened here in 1898.
caption_sv: Umjetnički paviljon ima željeznu konstrukciju izrađenu za milenijsku izložbu u Budimpešti 1896. Prenesen je u Zagreb i otvoren 1898.
photo_caption_en: The Art Pavilion on King Tomislav Square
photo_caption_sv: Umjetnički paviljon na Trgu kralja Tomislava

caption_en: In 1889 the new Botanical Garden joined the two ends of the U.
caption_sv: Godine 1889. novi Botanički vrt spojio je dva kraja slova U.

caption_en: On Marulić Square a building for the University Library and the Land Archive was finished in 1913. The State Archives are still in it.
caption_sv: Na Marulićevu trgu 1913. dovršena je zgrada za Sveučilišnu knjižnicu i Zemaljski arhiv. U njoj je i danas Hrvatski državni arhiv.

caption_en: On Republic of Croatia Square stands the National Theatre by Fellner and Helmer. It opened in 1895, when Emperor Franz Joseph visited.
caption_sv: Na Trgu Republike Hrvatske stoji Hrvatsko narodno kazalište, djelo Fellnera i Helmera. Otvoreno je 1895., za careva posjeta Zagrebu.
sources: Croatian National Theatre; HNK u Zagrebu (hr); landmark card

caption_en: Beside it is Hermann Bollé's building for the Museum of Arts and Crafts and its school, finished in 1888.
caption_sv: Pokraj njega je zgrada Muzeja za umjetnost i obrt i njegove škole, djelo Hermanna Bolléa iz 1888.
sources: Museum of Arts and Crafts; landmark card

caption_en: Today the horseshoe is still a chain of squares with parks, lined with museums and institutions.
caption_sv: Potkova je i danas niz trgova s perivojima, uz koje su muzeji i ustanove.
